method.rng: python random.seed(20261022); random.sample per group in order concepts,skills,procedures,rules,faults,scenarios,glossary,rooms,learning_resources,3d_downloads; each population sorted by id; n = max(minimum, ceil(10% of population))
method.checks: cited sources re-fetched (urllib cache + WebFetch for blocked pages), numbers/claims grepped in source text, covers vs content, confidence label (manufacturer/standard/regulator = verified-primary; Wikipedia/trade press = verified-secondary)
method.verdict_scale: pass / minor (wording, label, small unsourced add-on) / fail (unsupported or wrong fact, wrong licence) / unreachable

Scenario required_gear / signal_flow are not checked against equipment specs or any source: the only FAIL (one 4-output HA400 feeding 5 headphones) and a mis-wired DHD RX2 (surface used as I/O) come from there.

Inconsistent confidence labels: manufacturer/regulator documents (DPA, Rane, TI, Genelec, Yamaha, Ampetronic, ARS) labelled verified-secondary while the same publishers are verified-primary elsewhere; and two supporting blogs labelled unverified. 22 findings, harmless to facts but undermines the label as a trust signal.
